tijdlijn.beschrijving: An overview of what needs to be arranged and when after a death. Use this checklist as a guide for your next of kin. The exact order may vary per situation.
tijdlijn.disclaimer: Note: This overview is informational and not legal advice. The deadlines and obligations may vary per situation. Always consult a notary or legal advisor for your specific situation.

huisarts.titel: Call the GP or attending physician
huisarts.beschrijving: The doctor establishes death and issues a death certificate. Without this certificate, the funeral cannot be arranged.

uitvaart.beschrijving: Contact the funeral director or insurance. They will guide the further procedure and arrange transport. Legal deadline (Dutch Burial Act art. 19): burial or cremation within 6 working days of death.

naasten.titel: Inform next of kin and emergency contacts
naasten.beschrijving: Notify immediate family members, emergency contacts and, if applicable, the employer.

donor.beschrijving: Check as soon as possible whether there is a donor registration. Speed is essential for organ donation.

wilsverklaring.beschrijving: If applicable: check whether an advance directive or treatment prohibition has been recorded.

notaris.beschrijving: The notary opens the will and informs about the heirs, the executor and any legacies.

werkgever.beschrijving: Notify the employer. Request payment of any outstanding holiday pay and unpaid salary. Check for a survivor's pension at mijnpensioenoverzicht.nl. Apply for the Anw benefit (general survivors' benefit) via SVB (0800-0765) — must be done within 1 year of death. The Anw only applies when the partner's income is below the statutory threshold.

pensioenen.beschrijving: Check which pension schemes the deceased had at mijnpensioenoverzicht.nl. Apply for the survivor's pension with the relevant pension provider. Also contact the SVB for the Anw benefit (0800-0765) — must be applied for within 1 year.

aangifte.beschrijving: Register the death at the civil registry of the municipality where the death occurred, within 6 working days (Dutch Civil Code art. 1:19h). Bring: the doctor's death certificate and your own ID. In many municipalities registration is also possible digitally via DigiD.

documenten.beschrijving: Collect the ID, marriage certificate, policies, will and bank statements.

verzekeringen.beschrijving: Report the death to all insurance companies: health insurance, life insurance, household, liability, term life.

bank.beschrijving: Inform the bank. Accounts are transferred to the heirs' names. Arrange payment orders and possibly an escrow account for the estate.

woning.beschrijving: Notify the landlord or mortgage provider. For rental: cancel or transfer the tenancy to the partner's name (Civil Code art. 7:268). For ownership: notify the mortgage provider and apply for any term life insurance payout. Don't forget: energy supplier, water company and municipality (property tax).

abonnementen.beschrijving: Cancel phone, internet, TV subscriptions, rental or lease contracts, memberships and streaming services.

uitkeringen.beschrijving: Report the death to all institutions that provided benefits. Late reporting may lead to overpayment recovery. SVB (state pension AOW, survivors Anw): 0800-0765. UWV (unemployment, disability): 0900-9294. Municipality (social assistance): local office. Tax Authority (housing/healthcare/childcare allowances): 0800-0543 — stop allowances per date of death.

digitaal.beschrijving: Close or transfer online accounts: email, social media, cloud storage, webshops. Check for cryptocurrency.

erfbelasting.beschrijving: File an inheritance tax return with the Tax Authority (0800-0543) within 8 months of death (Dutch Succession Act art. 45). 2025 exemptions: partner € 795,156 — child € 25,187 — other € 2,658. An extension can be requested.

aanvaarding.beschrijving: Heirs must choose: unconditional acceptance, conditional acceptance (beneficiair), or rejection. Recommendation: choose conditional acceptance if there is any doubt about debts. Warning: taking or selling belongings of the deceased counts as unconditional acceptance (Civil Code 4:192), even without a formal declaration. A declaration of conditional acceptance must be made before a notary or cantonal court.

boedelverdeling.beschrijving: Inventory all assets and debts. Distribute the estate according to the will or statutory inheritance law. The executor coordinates this.

inkomstenbelasting.beschrijving: File the F-return (income tax return upon death) before 30 April of the year following death. The deceased's DigiD remains usable by heirs or authorised persons for up to 1 year after death.

socialMedia.beschrijving: Delete or set memorial mode for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and other social media accounts.

legeStaat.uitvaart: Record your funeral wishes so next of kin know what you want.
legeStaat.wilsverklaring: Record your medical wishes and treatment directives.
legeStaat.notaris: Record your will details and notary contact.
legeStaat.documenten: Upload your important documents, such as your passport or policies.
legeStaat.naasten: Add emergency contacts so next of kin know who to reach.
legeStaat.huisarts: No GP recorded in emergency contacts.
legeStaat.verzekeringen: No insurance policies recorded in the estate.
legeStaat.bank: No bank accounts recorded in the estate.
legeStaat.aangifte: Fill in your city of residence to see the municipality.
legeStaat.socialMedia: No social media accounts recorded in digital assets.
legeStaat.woning: No property recorded in the estate.
legeStaat.werkgever: Fill in your employer details so next of kin know who to notify.
legeStaat.pensioenen: Fill in the pension fund on the employer card in your profile.

persoonlijk.beschrijving: Let's get started. We'll ask you a few questions to set up your profile.
persoonlijk.toelichtingNaam: Your full name as on your ID.
persoonlijk.vraagGeboortedatum: What is your date of birth?
persoonlijk.vraagContact: How can next of kin reach you?
persoonlijk.toelichtingContact: Optional — used for your emergency card.

noodcontact.beschrijving: Who is the most important person to be informed if something happens to you?
noodcontact.toelichtingContactpersoon: This can be your partner, child, friend, or neighbor.
noodcontact.vraagTelefoon: What number can this person be reached at?
noodcontact.vraagRol: What role does this person have?
noodcontact.toelichtingRol: You can add more contacts later (doctor, notary, etc.).

testament.beschrijving: Do you have a will? If so, what kind? This is not required — you can always fill it in later.
testament.toelichtingTestament: A will determines who your heirs are and how your assets are divided.
testament.vraagSoort: What type of will do you have?
testament.toelichtingNotaris: Optional — useful for next of kin to know.
testament.tipTekst: You can check this via the Central Will Register (CTR) or with your notary. Lumio will then help you record everything neatly.

uitvaart.beschrijving: Have you thought about your funeral wishes? You don't have to fill in everything now — every choice helps your loved ones later.
uitvaart.vraagVoorkeur: Do you prefer burial or cremation?
uitvaart.toelichtingVoorkeur: You can always change this later.
uitvaart.vraagLocatie: Do you have a preferred location?
uitvaart.toelichtingLocatie: E.g. a church, chapel, at home, or a specific cemetery.
uitvaart.vraagMuziek: Is there music you would like to be played?
uitvaart.toelichtingMuziek: You can name one or more songs here.

digitaal.beschrijving: Do you have important online accounts? Think of email, social media, or cloud storage. One example is enough to start.
digitaal.vraagAccount: Which online account is most important to you?
digitaal.toelichtingAccount: Think of your email, Facebook, Google, iCloud, or banking app.
digitaal.vraagInstructie: What should next of kin do with this account?
digitaal.toelichtingInstructie: E.g. keep, delete, set memorial status.
digitaal.instructiePlaceholder: E.g. 'Close account after death' or 'Keep photos'
digitaal.infoTekst: You can add unlimited accounts, assets and passwords later. This is just a starting point.
